name: Human
naming: Every human receives a first name at birth, chosen by their parents to honour a valiant ancestor, a legendary hero or a virtue, and keeps it for life. First names are clearly gendered and follow the tradition of their region of origin. The family name is inherited and recalls the history of the house: a trade, a place or a social rank.

nouvelle-aubaine.text: ***As an inhabitant of Nouvelle-Aubaine***, you grew up under the banner of the House of Colbert, whose kings and queens rule from the Bastion, your capital. Like the rest of your people, you have a taste for chivalry, engraved armour and fine fabrics, and for a polished diplomacy that serves as well in a lord's court as on the merchant roads. A stranger who comes among you is met with warm courtesy, and closely watched for as long as their intentions remain unknown.

heraldry.name: Banner of the House of Colbert

landenheit.text: ***As a citizen of Landenheit***, you come from an Empire where every project begins with research, whether the task is building an automaton or refining a simple mechanism. Precision matters more than impulse there, and in smoking forges and engineering workshops people work methodically at marrying magic to the machine. Steam trains run from Eisenriese, the capital, to the Empire's citadels and factories, and airships cross its skies. A Landenheiter is often easy to spot by their reinforced leather clothes, fitted with exposed gears.

victoria.text: ***As a Victorian***, you know the misty lanes of your Monarchy's gothic cities, its occult libraries and its hushed salons, where philosophy and magic are argued with passion. Your people care about the smallest detail, from velvet embroidery to the esoteric symbols engraved on their jewellery, and are fond of long coats. A Victorian sees a key to the mysteries of Eden in every relic and every ancient manuscript, and pursues those mysteries with quiet determination, never dispelling the shadow that gives them their fascination.

heraldry.name: Arms of Victoria
heraldry.blazon: Quarterly per fess wavy purpure and sable: in the first, a lion rampant Or; in the second, an estoile of six rays Or; in the third, a book closed Or; in the fourth, a raven Or.

al-wahaa.text: ***As an Al-Waahi***, you belong to a people who cross the desert from oasis to oasis, steering by the stars and by the shifting breath of the sirocco. The Al-Waahi hold it a sacred duty to offer food and fresh water to any traveller. Trust is earned around stalls of spices, light silks and medicinal potions, and many deals there are settled by barter, for in their eyes the true treasure is exchange and shared knowledge. You wear loose tunics and protective veils, adorned with copper jewellery and polished glass beads.

roleplay.lifespan: Rarely beyond 90 years, though some have had their lives lengthened by magic or by mysterious pacts
roleplay.text:
Coming from another world, the humans of Eden had to rely on diplomacy, adaptability and ingenuity to earn a place among ancient and powerful civilisations. Their meteoric rise has made them a major power, though their origins remain obscure and surrounded by myth.

The human language of Eden is direct, shaped by the idioms of the many cultures humans have traded and negotiated with. Through that trade they imposed it on the other peoples, and it became Common.

Your regional origin is the region you grew up in.
